subject: Noxus regional heraldry, independent painted adaptation for troop equipment

reference_observed.status: official response fetched and actual icon pixels visually inspected; no runtime/asset acceptance implied
reference_observed.source_selection: Riot Legends of Runeterra core globals region entry; Universe region JSON has context but no iconfield.

shape_notes: Bilateral red war-crest with broad axe-like hooked/crescent outerlobes.
Outer upperhooks frame a pair of rounded transparent openings; retain these negative spaces.
Narrow upright central upper point, angular inward middle notches and long lower tapered portions with deep transparent channels.
Exact central cuts/contour are resolved against the actual private128pixel source, not a guessed genericaxe.
No Demacian featherrows, winged upright sword, Riot corporatefist, Leaguewordmark, BlackRoseflower or unrelatedcoatofarms.
Geometric notes are factual visual observations, not an official interpretation of symbolic meaning.

production_direction.method: Independently paint same geometriccrest on worn clothstamp, buckler, serviceplate or harness; never pasteoriginalPNGpixels.
production_direction.materials: Restrained red, pale weathered paint or contrasting darkiron appropriate to selected Noxian material; no requirement to reproduce a UIgradient.
production_direction.native_readability: Preserve silhouette, paired uppercutouts and centralaxis on a readable surface. Enlarging/moving a badge is preferable to accepting an unidentified redsmudge.
production_direction.upgrade_gap: Base chipped plainstamp versus upgrade more readable edged/embossed samecrest; independent equipment/body progression stillrequired.
production_direction.continuity: Attach to a real cloth/armor/harness surface and keep perspective/folds/light/wear coherent through complete actionframes.
production_direction.current_blank_rig: Body emblem may remain blank while independently owned portrait/work proceeds. This metadata does not overwrite selected masters or finish their heraldry.
production_direction.review_gate: Actual native-size paint and moving-pose comparison plus exact source/frames hashes needed before acceptance.

rights.note: No redistribution/license clearance inferred from CDN availability. Exclude originalPNG/fullillustrations/private response bodies from runtime and source/artpackages.
